is the pseudonym of a Japanese author best known for his original novel series - Mushoku Tensei and Orc Eroica. Magonote rarely appears on-camera and likes to keep his privacy. When he does make an appearance, he wears a characteristic helmet to cover his face. This helmet is of the same model donned by Orsted (a character in Mushoku Tensei) to keep his curse at bay. ==Career==
Magonote first started uploading his work on the user-generated novel publishing site, Shosetsuka ni Naro in November of 2012. His first upload was the web novel "Mushoku Tensei".

Shirotaka (シロタカ, lit. "White Hawk"), sometimes also spelled as Sirotaka, is a Japanese illustrator and character designer best known for their work on Mushoku Tensei as the illustrator for the light novel. ==Career==
Shirotaka gained initial prominence through uploading illustrations on Pixiv during a brief period in 2011. They made their major debut in January of 2014 as the illustrator for the light novel series Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu (無職転生 - 異世界行ったら本気だす) written by Rifujin na Magonote. Other than Mushoku Tensei, they have also worked on the light novel Netogehai Akuma no Negai Kanaemasu (ネトゲ廃悪魔の願い叶えます) written by Ubune Coma, which was also released in June of the same year.
